items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I was working with Johnny Neal's Midnight Ramblers.

ctx.x: Yeah. Me and Jonesy used to jack up cars and steal wheels. Well, they did that to us, you know. So we'd go into a good neighborhood and jack up a car, and take the wheels to fit our car, you know, so we were straight. I'm trying to think, Jonesy and myself... Well, somebody got mixed up with some people that belonged to the sheriff or something, and he gave us so many hours to get out of town.
